questions.text: Teacher Attendance & 'Ghost Teacher' Prevention: Ensure teachers are present: (1) Biometric/Digital attendance tracking; (2) Random spot checks; (3) Payroll audit (verify identity); (4) Community monitoring (parents report absence); (5) Substitute teacher protocols; (6) Disciplinary process for absenteeism; (7) Ghost worker removal policy.
questions.evidence_required: Attendance logs, Payroll audit reports, Disciplinary records, Community monitoring reports
questions.africa_specific_notes: Teacher absenteeism is a crisis (20-40% in some areas). 'Ghost teachers' drain budgets. Digital tracking helps.

questions.text: Teacher Code of Conduct & Ethics: Prevent abuse and misconduct: (1) Signed Code of Conduct (sexual harassment, corporal punishment); (2) Background checks (criminal record); (3) Reporting channels for abuse (anonymous for students); (4) Zero-tolerance policy enforcement; (5) Ethics training; (6) Teacher registration (TSC number); (7) Whistleblower protection.
questions.evidence_required: Code of Conduct documents, Background check policy, Abuse reporting logs, Enforcement records
questions.africa_specific_notes: Sexual harassment ('sex for grades') and corporal punishment are major issues. Safe reporting channels essential.

questions.text: Exam Security & Anti-Cheating: Prevent exam malpractice: (1) Secure paper chain of custody (tracking delivery); (2) Digital exam proctoring (AI or human); (3) Plagiarism detection; (4) Impersonation prevention (ID checks); (5) Leakage prevention protocols; (6) Results processing security; (7) Sanctions for cheating.
questions.evidence_required: Exam security protocols, Proctoring logs, Malpractice reports, Chain of custody forms
questions.africa_specific_notes: Exam leakage is a national security issue in some countries. Cheating undermines entire system credibility.

questions.text: Credential Verification & Anti-Fraud: Prevent fake degrees: (1) Digital certificate issuance (QR codes, blockchain); (2) Public verification portal; (3) Graduate registry; (4) Revocation policy for fraud; (5) Secure paper certificates (watermarks); (6) Integration with employers; (7) Audit of issued certificates.
questions.evidence_required: Certificate samples (security features), Verification portal URL, Fraud detection stats
questions.africa_specific_notes: Fake degrees common. Employers need instant verification. Digital credentials gaining traction.

questions.text: School Registration & Licensing: Compliance with Ministry: (1) Valid registration certificate; (2) Compliance with safety standards (buildings, fire); (3) Compliance with curriculum standards; (4) Teacher qualification compliance; (5) Fee structure approval; (6) Health & Sanitation inspection; (7) Renewal status.
questions.evidence_required: Registration certificate, Inspection reports, Health clearance
questions.africa_specific_notes: Unregistered schools (informal settlements) common. Safety standards often ignored (building collapse risk).

questions.text: EdTech Regulatory Compliance: Compliance for digital providers: (1) E-learning content approval (KICD, etc.); (2) Data protection registration; (3) Consumer protection compliance; (4) Tax compliance (digital services tax); (5) Cross-border data transfer compliance; (6) Age-appropriate design code; (7) Cybercrime act compliance.
questions.evidence_required: Content approval letters, Data protection certificate, Tax filings
questions.africa_specific_notes: EdTech regulation evolving. Content approval mandatory in some countries (e.g., Kenya). Digital tax enforcement increasing.

questions.text: Child Protection & Safeguarding Policy: Protect students from harm: (1) Comprehensive safeguarding policy; (2) Designated Safeguarding Officer; (3) Staff training on safeguarding; (4) Digital safety (cyberbullying prevention); (5) Physical safety (secure compound); (6) Reporting & referral mechanisms; (7) Support for victims.
questions.evidence_required: Safeguarding policy, Training logs, Incident reports (anonymized), Safety audit
questions.africa_specific_notes: Schools must be safe havens. Bullying, corporal punishment, and sexual abuse are risks. Digital safety new frontier.

questions.text: Inclusion & Non-Discrimination Governance: Ensure equal access: (1) Non-discrimination policy (religion, tribe, gender, disability); (2) Admission transparency; (3) Support for pregnant students (re-entry policy); (4) Support for students with disabilities; (5) Scholarship/Bursary allocation fairness; (6) Language inclusion; (7) Grievance mechanism for discrimination.
questions.evidence_required: Inclusion policy, Admission records, Bursary allocation logs, Accessibility audit
questions.africa_specific_notes: Discrimination based on tribe/religion happens. Pregnant girls often expelled (policy shifting to re-entry). Disability inclusion often poor.

scoring_notes: Layer 3 (Governance) for Education in SSA: Teacher accountability and student safeguarding are the pillars. Exam integrity is crucial for the value of the education. Regulatory compliance ensures baseline safety and quality.
